svg.title: Synthetic block bootstrap
svg.desc: One thousand seeded draws of two synthetic blocks produce 243 WER values at 0%, 513 at 16.6667%, and 244 at 33.3333%. The empirical cumulative curve is discrete. This illustrates bootstrap behavior, not model performance.
svg.metadata: {"source":"tests/support.py:CI_BLOCKS; src/shono/eval/ci.py:blockwise_bootstrap_ci","inputs_and_results":{"records":[["A","আমি ভাত খাই","আমি ভাত খাই"],["A","সে ঘরে থাকে","সে ঘরে থাকে"],["B","আমি ভাত খাই","আমি ডাল খাই"],["B","তুমি ভাল আছ","তুমি ভাল নাই"]],"metric":"wer","seed":0,"n_resamples":1000,"confidence":0.95,"point":0.16666666666666666,"lower":0.0,"upper":0.3333333333333333,"n_blocks":2,"n_segments":4,"distribution":[{"wer":0.0,"count":243},{"wer":0.16666666666666666,"count":513},{"wer":0.3333333333333333,"count":244}]},"verified_source_files_sha256":{"tests/support.py":"f8f0f647a6fa0f883855de009ec4527a7b3cfd6a063cc6822b43cb318a6b80a7","src/shono/eval/score.py":"175d2373a2d26e123b3699f8aa4ad17a7ea428988587efec04ec8a0ad1af3e32","src/shono/eval/normalize.py":"3948cd7dcdcb2be2c7cbd9c0fd3f746e5e944a4b5fae7e9614d0d6d7fb4444fe","src/shono/eval/ci.py":"157ee78b2da4d59d0202010ceb0a77f85190a411429b97b594b7fed62680fe77"}}
